capabilities: Publish the current note as a Feishu/Lark Docx document
Sync a whole folder while preserving its hierarchy in Feishu/Lark
Update only changed blocks incrementally, or overwrite the remote document fully
Rewrite Markdown and Wiki links into remote document references and upload local images
Trigger automatic sync on save or via a Git pre-push hook
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is a one-way publisher: local Markdown is the source and Feishu/Lark documents are the output, not a two-way vault sync.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns that lark-cli versions below 1.0.53 cause Untitled titles and sync errors, that remote manual edits are overwritten (local Markdown wins), and that a failed hook sync blocks the git push.
problem: Notes written in Obsidian stay local, so teams that read, comment and collaborate in Feishu/Lark need manual copying to see the content there.
summary: Publishes and syncs Obsidian Markdown notes to Feishu/Lark cloud documents through the local lark-cli, with block-level incremental updates.
